steps.title: 4 Easy Steps to Start Your Project
steps.subtitle: Free consultation, transparent process, maximum results. We guide you from idea to launch in 4 simple steps.

steps.title: Consultation & Needs Briefing
steps.desc: Share your vision and business needs with us. We'll listen, understand your target audience, and formulate the right digital solution.

steps.title: Solution & Package Recommendation
steps.desc: Based on our analysis, we recommend the best website type and investment package no bloated features, no hidden costs.

cta.title: Ready to Start Your Project?

questions.q: How long does website development take?
questions.a: Typically 1-2 weeks for a landing page, 2-4 weeks for a company profile, and 4-8 weeks for e-commerce or web applications, depending on feature complexity.

questions.q: Do I need to prepare domain & hosting?
questions.a: For the Landing Page package, you prepare domain and hosting yourself or we can handle it for an additional fee. For the Company Profile package, the .com domain and hosting are included free for 1 year, so you can sit back and relax.
Absolutely! All websites we build are guaranteed to be responsive and look perfect on all devices (desktop, tablet, and smartphone).

questions.q: Is there a warranty after the website is completed?
questions.a: Yes, we provide 1 month free maintenance after your website goes live. We also offer extended maintenance packages if needed.
Of course! We always listen to your needs. Every project includes a discussion session to ensure the desired features align with your business goals.

questions.q: Can I see the website progress?
questions.a: Yes, we provide regular progress updates and you can see the development directly on our development server.
